quiz_item.question: What is the primary purpose of the curved P-trap installed directly beneath every household sink, shower, and floor drain?
options: A. To boost incoming municipal water pressure before it reaches the hot and cold faucet valves.
B. To grind up solid food waste so it does not enter the septic tank or city sewer main.
C. To hold a standing water seal that blocks toxic, flammable, and foul-smelling sewer gases from rising out of the drain-waste-vent system into the building.
D. To filter dissolved calcium and magnesium minerals out of potable drinking water.
choices: A. To boost incoming municipal water pressure before it reaches the hot and cold faucet valves.
B. To grind up solid food waste so it does not enter the septic tank or city sewer main.
C. To hold a standing water seal that blocks toxic, flammable, and foul-smelling sewer gases from rising out of the drain-waste-vent system into the building.
D. To filter dissolved calcium and magnesium minerals out of potable drinking water.
quiz_item.correct_answer: C. To hold a standing water seal that blocks toxic, flammable, and foul-smelling sewer gases from rising out of the drain-waste-vent system into the building.
quiz_item.explanation: Correct Answer (C): A P-trap retains a small volume of water after each use, creating an airtight liquid barrier that prevents hazardous sewer gases (such as methane and hydrogen sulfide) from entering living spaces.

Stack Vent Equalization: Open roof vent pipes admit atmospheric air to prevent siphoning of fixture traps.

Step 2 - Winterization Valve Setup: Close interior isolation valves to outdoor faucets and open small side waste bleeder caps.
Step 3 - Drain Pitch Layout: Sketch the main soil stack showing proper downward grade toward the municipal sewer.
Step 4 - Vent Stack Termination: Route the continuous vent stack vertically through the roof plane away from windows.

patrol_quiz_bank.scenario_prompt: What is the primary purpose of the curved P-trap installed directly beneath every household sink, shower, and floor drain?
patrol_quiz_bank.question: What is the primary purpose of the curved P-trap installed directly beneath every household sink, shower, and floor drain?
options: A. To boost incoming municipal water pressure before it reaches the hot and cold faucet valves.
B. To grind up solid food waste so it does not enter the septic tank or city sewer main.
C. To hold a standing water seal that blocks toxic, flammable, and foul-smelling sewer gases from rising out of the drain-waste-vent system into the building.
D. To filter dissolved calcium and magnesium minerals out of potable drinking water.
choices: A. To boost incoming municipal water pressure before it reaches the hot and cold faucet valves.
B. To grind up solid food waste so it does not enter the septic tank or city sewer main.
C. To hold a standing water seal that blocks toxic, flammable, and foul-smelling sewer gases from rising out of the drain-waste-vent system into the building.
D. To filter dissolved calcium and magnesium minerals out of potable drinking water.
patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: C. To hold a standing water seal that blocks toxic, flammable, and foul-smelling sewer gases from rising out of the drain-waste-vent system into the building.
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (C): A P-trap retains a small volume of water after each use, creating an airtight liquid barrier that prevents hazardous sewer gases (such as methane and hydrogen sulfide) from entering living spaces.

patrol_quiz_bank.scenario_prompt: What happens to a home drainage system if it lacks properly installed air vents?
patrol_quiz_bank.question: What happens to a home drainage system if it lacks properly installed air vents?
options: A. The water heater automatically shuts off its burner
B. The pipes become air-bound like a narrow-necked bottle, slowing drainage
C. Cold supply water reverses direction and flows back to the city main
D. The water meter records double the actual household water usage
choices: A. The water heater automatically shuts off its burner
B. The pipes become air-bound like a narrow-necked bottle, slowing drainage
C. Cold supply water reverses direction and flows back to the city main
D. The water meter records double the actual household water usage
patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: B. The pipes become air-bound like a narrow-necked bottle, slowing drainage
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (B): Without air vents to admit atmospheric air behind flowing wastewater, the drainage system becomes air-bound like an inverted small-necked bottle (p. 9).

patrol_quiz_bank.scenario_prompt: Why do plumbers prefer a wheeled pipe cutter over a hacksaw when cutting copper tubing?
patrol_quiz_bank.question: Why do plumbers prefer a wheeled pipe cutter over a hacksaw when cutting copper tubing?
options: A. It threads the outside of the copper pipe while cutting
B. It melts the copper edge so no soldering flux is required
C. It makes a straight, square cut and avoids bending or crushing the pipe
D. It automatically flares the end of the tubing for compression nuts
choices: A. It threads the outside of the copper pipe while cutting
B. It melts the copper edge so no soldering flux is required
C. It makes a straight, square cut and avoids bending or crushing the pipe
D. It automatically flares the end of the tubing for compression nuts
patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: C. It makes a straight, square cut and avoids bending or crushing the pipe
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (C): A pipe cutter rolls smoothly around the tubing to produce a straight, square cut while preventing soft copper pipe from bending or crushing (p. 23).

patrol_quiz_bank.question: Which safety component on a domestic hot-water heating system allows expanding water and steam to escape so the tank does not explode?
options: A. The rubber force cup plunger
B. The municipal water meter dial
C. The cast-iron drainpipe coupling
D. The temperature and pressure-relief valve
choices: A. The rubber force cup plunger
B. The municipal water meter dial
C. The cast-iron drainpipe coupling
D. The temperature and pressure-relief valve
patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: D. The temperature and pressure-relief valve
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (D): All hot-water heating systems use a temperature and pressure-relief valve to release expanding water and steam before dangerous pressure causes an explosion (p. 13).

patrol_quiz_bank.scenario_prompt: Why is standard PVC plastic pipe no longer recommended for indoor hot- and cold-water supply systems?
patrol_quiz_bank.question: Why is standard PVC plastic pipe no longer recommended for indoor hot- and cold-water supply systems?
options: A. Hot water makes standard PVC pipe lose its structural strength
B. Standard PVC pipe rusts internally after fifty years of use
C. PVC pipe conducts electricity whenever a thunderstorm occurs
D. PVC pipe cannot be cut with a hand saw or tubing cutter
choices: A. Hot water makes standard PVC pipe lose its structural strength
B. Standard PVC pipe rusts internally after fifty years of use
C. PVC pipe conducts electricity whenever a thunderstorm occurs
D. PVC pipe cannot be cut with a hand saw or tubing cutter
patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: A. Hot water makes standard PVC pipe lose its structural strength
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (A): Standard PVC loses its strength when exposed to hot water, making it unsuitable for indoor hot- and cold-water supply piping (p. 28).
